browser.open.title: Open Browser
browser.container.title: Browser
browser.view.name: Browser
configuration.title: Browser Panel
browser.defaultUrl.description: Default URL to open in the browser (Home target). Change the port by editing this URL.
browser.retainContextWhenHidden.descript: Keep the page state (scroll position, forms, JS state, websockets) alive while the view is hidden. Takes effect after reload.
browser.historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep (oldest are removed first).
browser.proxyEnabled.description: Route pages through a local proxy that strips frame-blocking headers (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors). Fixes sites that only block embedding; sites that need a real browser session (logins, heavy JS — e.g. PayPal, Microsoft sign-in) still render blank — use Open in external browser for those.
browser.acceptSelfSignedCerts.descriptio: Accept self-signed certificates when loading pages and checking reachability. Keep this on for local https dev servers; turn it off to enforce certificate validation on all requests (then self-signed hosts show as unreachable).
